messages.subject: Slate - Birchall Stone mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Thornaby's counsel have come back on the SA (their v2 redline). The moveable points: founder cap they want at 1.5x (we proposed 2x), warranty claim period they want 18 months (we had 24), de-minimis £35k, and a longer non-compete (18 months). I'd suggest we land the cap at 1.75x, claim period 21 months, de-minimis £30k, non-compete 15 months. Comfortable?

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
